example.title: Roller skate shop with a big wave sign (Rip City Skates)
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A late-1970s single-storey skate shop: a blue-and-white painted block with a tall wave-shaped sign panel, big lettering 'SKATES', a projecting pole sign above, wide shop windows crowded with skates and decks, parking meters on the kerb. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
